title: Accident Plan Cancellation at the Plan Holder's Request, Northgate Protect
content:
A plan holder may cancel a Northgate Protect Accident 2-Year, 3-Year or 4-Year plan; the cancellation is the plan holder's own decision, and the refund goes to the card that paid the plan charge.

**Refund basis.** For a cancellation the plan holder requests on an Accident-tier plan, and only for such a cancellation, the refund outside the full-refund window is the Accident plan cancellation refund, with the basis prorated unused days; a cancellation the plan holder requests on a Standard-tier plan is refunded under the Standard plan cancellation refund, and any other one-time plan refunds the plan price times the unused coverage days divided by the total coverage days, less a cancellation fee equal to the lesser of the tier's cancellation fee percentage of the plan price and the tier's cancellation fee cap, rounded down to the cent and never below zero, with the basis prorated unused days.

**When the refund can be figured.** The Accident plan cancellation refund is not worked out until every claim filed on the plan carries the administrator's decision. The Accident plan cancellation refund is fixed only after every claim approved on the plan before today carries a settlement. Put the other way: while any claim filed on the plan shows no decision, the refund is not worked out, and while any claim approved on the plan before today shows no settlement on the plan's ledger, the refund is not fixed.

## Invocation: `cancel_accident_plan_cec4ac7d`

**Capability.** Confirms the plan holder's cancellation request for the plan (the most recent request still waiting is marked confirmed; if none is waiting, a confirmed request is recorded), closes the plan as canceled with today's date, books one refund of the plan charge named, of the amount and on the basis passed in, credited to the external card that paid that charge, and reduces the plan's net premium paid by that refund.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks `cancel_accident_plan_cec4ac7d` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `plan_id` | The identifier of the plan being canceled, as read from the customer's plan holdings |
| `original_event_id` | The identifier of the plan charge to be refunded, as read from the plan's ledger |
| `refund_basis` | The basis of the refund, exactly one of the values below |
| `refund_amount_usd` | The cancellation refund, US dollars as a decimal number with 2 decimal places, never negative; any further digits are rounded half up to the cent |

| `refund_basis` value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `full_within_window` | Canceled inside the full-refund window with no claim filed |
| `prorated_unused_days` | Canceled outside that window and refunded for the unused coverage |
| `item_returned` | The covered item was returned or canceled |
| `billing_error` | The charge was made in error |
| `not_applicable` | No refund basis is stated, which books the refund without one |

**Return.** A text receipt: "Plan <plan_id> canceled on <date>: request <request_ref> confirmed; refund <refund_ref> of USD <amount> (<refund_basis>) credited to the external card that paid the plan; net premium paid now USD <premium>." with today's date, the confirmed request and new refund references, and two-decimal amounts. Receiving it means the cancellation and the refund were booked. Errors: a `refund_basis` outside the list, or a negative amount, is answered with an error; a charge not paid by an external card is answered "Error: this tool refunds only plan charges paid by an external card; nothing was changed."
